Givers.Name: Dante Rook
Givers.Greeting: Orders on the board, pay on delivery, burns on the house.

Quests.Title: Raw Materials
Quests.Summary: Dante Rook won't forge for a man who can't find his own iron. Scavenge mite dust and shard from the Battery Yard in the Ash Underpass, survive the swarm that lives there, and bring the dust back to the forge.
Quests.Done: You brought Dante his first batch of mite dust. He said it binds crystal to steel like gossip binds a neighbourhood.

Lines.Speaker: Dante Rook
Lines.Text: You want gear that remembers the monster it came from? Then you bring me the monster. Or the parts. Parts scream less.

Lines.Speaker: Dante Rook
Lines.Text: Battery Yard Scrap, in the Ash Underpass. Mites nest in the junk. Bring me their dust, and any shard you can pry loose.

Lines.Speaker: Malik
Lines.Text: And if the mites object?

Lines.Speaker: Dante Rook
Lines.Text: Then you have an argument with a swarm. Win it.

Steps.Objective: Go to Battery Yard Scrap Co. in the Ash Underpass.
Search the scrap piles for mite dust.
The swarm woke up. Squash the Glass Mites.
Pry the shard chunks out of the scrap.
Bring the materials to Dante Rook.
Hand Dante three Mite Dust.

Lines.Speaker: Dante Rook
Lines.Text: Mite dust. Good. It binds crystal to steel like gossip binds a neighbourhood.

Lines.Speaker: Dante Rook
Lines.Text: Keep the shard. You'll want it later. Come back when you've got the stomach for bigger game.

Quests.Title: Infestation at the Kiln Yard
Quests.Summary: A Forgewright kiln yard going up in the Ash Underpass is crawling with Glass Mites. Light the work lamps to drive the swarm into the open, crush it, and hold the yard until the last of them gives up.
Quests.Done: The kiln yard is clear. Petra Holm says you still owe her a lunchbox.

Lines.Speaker: Dante Rook
Lines.Text: My crew's building a new kiln yard in the Ash Underpass. Was building. The mites moved in overnight.

Lines.Speaker: Dante Rook
Lines.Text: Light the work lamps, they hate light. Then step on them. They hate that more.

Steps.Objective: Go to the kiln yard in the Ash Underpass.

Lines.Speaker: Petra Holm
Lines.Text: You're Dante's hunter? They came out of the shard pile at midnight. Ate my lunch. Ate the lunchbox.

Lines.Speaker: Malik
Lines.Text: I'll get you a new lunchbox.

Lines.Speaker: Petra Holm
Lines.Text: Get me a yard without bugs and I'll buy my own.

Steps.Name: LAMPS
Steps.Prompt: Press E to light the work lamp
Steps.Objective: Light the three work lamps.
The light flushed them out. Crush the swarm.
Hold the yard until the swarm gives up.

Lines.Speaker: Petra Holm
Lines.Text: That's the last of them. Tell Dante the kiln's back on, and that he owes me a lunchbox.

Steps.Objective: Report to Dante Rook.

Lines.Speaker: Dante Rook
Lines.Text: Petra says you saved the yard and owe her a lunchbox. I'm not getting involved.

Lines.Speaker: Dante Rook
Lines.Text: There's a golem out at the quarry that's been sitting on my favourite seam. Next time.

Quests.Title: Old Slab
Quests.Summary: A Shard Golem the miners call Old Slab has claimed the best seam in the Quartz Badlands Quarry. Read it with the Third Eye, break it, and haul home the shard it was sitting on.
Quests.Done: Old Slab is rubble and the seam is Dante's. He hums when he talks about it.

Lines.Speaker: Dante Rook
Lines.Text: The miners call it Old Slab. Sits on the richest seam in the Badlands like a hen on an egg.

Lines.Speaker: Dante Rook
Lines.Text: Read it first. A golem's heart shows if you know how to look. Then break the heart. Gently, if you can. You can't.

Steps.Objective: Drive out to the Quartz Badlands Quarry.

Steps.Name: Old Slab
Steps.Objective: Read Old Slab with the Third Eye. It hasn't noticed you. Yet.

Steps.Name: Old Slab
Steps.Objective: Break Old Slab. Dodge the slam, then hit the core.
Gather the shard Old Slab was sitting on.
Bring the news to Dante Rook.

Lines.Speaker: Dante Rook
Lines.Text: Old Slab, finally. Here, take this core. Pulled it out of a golem last spring and it still beats. Keep it for the big one.

Lines.Speaker: Dante Rook
Lines.Text: Bad news. Old Slab was an apprentice. The quarry has a foreman, and the foreman just clocked in.

Quests.Title: The Foreman's Last Shift
Quests.Summary: The quarry's first golem has come up to see who is stealing from its seam. The Shard Golem Foreman calls mite swarms and rains crystal, and Dante needs its crowned core for something he will only call the big one.
Quests.Done: The Shard Golem Foreman fell in the quarry. Dante kept its crowned core for the big one.

Lines.Speaker: Dante Rook
Lines.Text: The Foreman himself is awake, and he's not happy about the staff cuts.

Lines.Speaker: Dante Rook
Lines.Text: Lightning stuns his crown. Break the striped plates and you'll see the core. Bring it home in one piece. Or two. I can work with two.

Lines.Speaker: Malik
Lines.Text: Any other advice?

Lines.Speaker: Dante Rook
Lines.Text: Don't stand where the ground glows.

Steps.Objective: Go to the rim of the Quartz Badlands Quarry.

Lines.Speaker: Dante Rook (phone)
Lines.Text: That's him. Shift lead of the whole quarry. Probably unionised.

Lines.Speaker: Malik
Lines.Text: Shift's over, boss.

Steps.Objective: Bring the Foreman's core to Dante Rook.

Lines.Speaker: Dante Rook
Lines.Text: The Foreman's core. Still warm, still bossy. I can hear it telling my anvil to work faster.

Lines.Speaker: Dante Rook
Lines.Text: I'm keeping this one in the forge. Don't make that face. Come back when you're ready. We're going to make something this city hasn't seen.

Quests.Title: The First Mythic
Quests.Summary: Dante Rook is ready to fire the old forge for the first mythic piece in a generation. He has the Foreman's core. He needs a golem core, shard and mite dust for the binding, and a bearer willing to hold the hammer while the metal remembers.
Quests.Done: Dante forged the first mythic piece in a generation, with the Foreman's core singing inside it.

Lines.Speaker: Dante Rook
Lines.Text: Mythic forging isn't smithing. It's persuasion. The core remembers what it was. We convince it to be something else.

Lines.Speaker: Malik
Lines.Text: And if it disagrees?

Lines.Speaker: Dante Rook
Lines.Text: Then we both lose our eyebrows. Bring the binding: one golem core, six shard, four mite dust.

Steps.Objective: Give Dante a Golem Core (Shard Golems drop them).
Give Dante six Shard Chunks.
Give Dante four Mite Dust.

Steps.Prompt: Press E to take the hammer
Steps.Objective: Take the hammer at Dante's forge.

Lines.Speaker: Dante Rook
Lines.Text: Strike when it sings. Not before. Not after. When.

Steps.Objective: Hold the hammer steady. The core remembers the quarry, and the quarry remembers back.

Lines.Speaker: Dante Rook
Lines.Text: Look at that. It's breathing. Every mythic piece breathes for the first hour. Then it just judges you quietly.

Steps.Name: Mythic Forged
Steps.Text: The first mythic piece in a generation cools in Dante's tongs.

Lines.Speaker: Dante Rook
Lines.Text: There. Your first mythic, a crystal core with the Foreman inside it. He would be proud, if he weren't in it.

Lines.Speaker: Malik
Lines.Text: What does it do?

Lines.Speaker: Dante Rook
Lines.Text: Whatever you can survive teaching it.
